purpose: Teach: 名画/切なく/点滅/水温/霜/躾/隠せ/家出

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、美術館の、絶対、名画、絶対、見たいな
lines.en: Mom, I really, really want to see the masterpieces at the art museum.
lines.style: Bright, insistent energy. Repeating 'really' with building intensity. Open-mouthed excitement. Leans forward. Not demanding — just unable to contain the wanting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くんが、本気で、絶対、大きくなって、絶対、ママ、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、切なく、絶対、なるわよ
lines.en: When you grow up, Sho, it's going to make Mom a little sad, you know.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself at first. Warm but tinged with something bittersweet. Slow delivery. A small catch in her voice — not melodrama, just truth slipping through. She's looking at him while saying it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お台所の、絶対、電気、絶対、点滅、絶対、してるよ
lines.en: Mom, the kitchen light is flickering again.
lines.style: Alert, almost urgent but still calm. Quick delivery. His noticing is matter-of-fact, not anxious — he's reporting what he sees. Straightforward tone, no elaboration.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お風呂の、本気で、絶対、水温、絶対、ちょうどよくしてあるわよ、翔くん
lines.en: The bath water is the right temperature for you, Sho.
lines.style: Competent and warm. Efficient — she's done this already. Slight lift at his name, reassuring without fussing. Practical love, not sentimental.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お庭、絶対、霜、絶対、降りてたよ
lines.en: There was frost on the garden this morning.
lines.style: Quiet, wondering tone. He's noticing something small and letting it sit with him. Gentle pace. Almost like he's thinking out loud, not reporting — just sharing what caught his eye. Slight trailing-off.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、躾、絶対、しっかり、絶対、守ってくれてるわね
lines.en: Sho, you're following what your father taught you so well.
lines.style: Genuine admiration in her voice. Slower, deliberate. She means it — not empty praise. A moment of real seeing. Warm and steady, like she's recognizing something true about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、悲しい時、絶対、隠せ、絶対、ない、絶対、けど、絶対、ママと、絶対、お話したいよ
lines.en: Mom, when I'm sad I can't hide it, but I want to talk to you about it.
lines.style: Vulnerable honesty. Quiet but unflinching. He's not asking permission — he's telling her something important. Slow, careful delivery. Slight tremor of sincerity, no drama. Direct eye contact in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、家出、絶対、なんて、絶対、しないでね、約束よ
lines.en: Sho, you won't run away, okay? That's a promise.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Close, almost whispered. Not fearful — grounded. A mother making something clear because she loves him. Slight pressure on 'promise.' Warm hand in her voice.
